verdict.rationale: Supermemory's container-tag model gives hard namespace isolation for private per-user/tenant memory (docs-4, docs-12, docs-24), while 'spaces' and the shared MCP layer let teams share focused context across agents/users (docs-36, docs-11, docs-35). This covers the core tenancy-plus-sharing story, but there's no documented granular permission/ACL system (e.g., read/write roles within a shared space) or independent verification that private/shared boundaries hold up in practice. Missing for 10: fine-grained per-user permissions within shared spaces, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the isolation and sharing guarantees.
